top_choice_rationale: Base editing by Liu alone is the cleanest defensible attribution on the slate and a real chemical advance: programmed conversion of a DNA base without cleavage, made possible by evolving an RNA-acting deaminase (TadA) into a DNA deaminase, new-to-nature catalysis judged on quantitative editing outcomes. It is simple, widely reproduced and already in patients, so it meets the game-changer test. Targeted protein degradation (P001) is a close second on quantitative ternary-complex chemistry but its credit is entangled with the cereblon glue strand and Sakamoto; nitrogenase and phase separation carry more open mechanism and attribution questions.
